notes: Each question is labeled with acceptable_source_ids derived from the KB TITLE/SECTION
semantics (not from the retrieval ranking being measured), so recall is non-circular.
A source_id is a chunk's article id: the CSV 'document_id' (shared across FR/EN) or a
markdown filename (e.g. 'telecom-faq.md', the curated FAQ). recall@k passes when ANY
acceptable source is in the top-k. Every question includes a greeting-prefixed variant,
the BUG-003 brittleness axis. FR questions lean on the curated FR FAQs + FR articles;
EN questions lean on the EN CSV articles (the FAQ md files are FR-only).
